text:
The patient's denial of gastrointestinal and urinary symptoms helps rule out other causes for the mass, but does not clarify its nature. We have a confirmed endometrial adenocarcinoma and an adnexal mass with normal CA-125 and CT, suggesting the mass may be a benign lesion like a fibroid or cyst, or potentially a synchronous primary ovarian tumor. I will proceed to diagnose the primary confirmed malignancy.
